description: Count records in one Lorain County GIS layer found by NAME, no url needed: "how many parcels", or counts BY a field such as city ("parcels by city"). layer = name words ("parcels") or a layer url; where = SQL filter; group_by = a field name or part of one ("city"). If several layers share the name it counts each and picks none; if the word matches several fields it counts by each.

group_by.description: Field name, or part of one ("city"), to count records by. Omit for one total.

layer.description: Layer name words, e.g. "parcels", or a Feature/Map Service layer url.

limit.description: Max groups when group_by is set (default 100, max 1000).

org_id.description: Optional ArcGIS orgId to override the default publisher.

where.description: SQL where clause to count a subset, e.g. "STATE = 'CO'". Default "1=1" (all records).

name: arcgis_lorain_count_records
title: Arcgis Lorain Count Records
